hero.title: Top GitHub contributors from
hero.subtitle: An open-source ranking of developers and students who build, commit, and contribute the most on GitHub. Join the movement.

info.title: How does the ranking work?
info.criteria: The ranking is based on the total number of GitHub contributions (commits + pull requests + code reviews) for the current year. Only public contributions are counted.
info.student_howto: To appear with the student badge (green), add "student", "étudiant" or "étudiante" to your GitHub bio or company field.
